crossRefs.note: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with…
Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances.…
The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

people.name: Israel

people.name: Philistia

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.
translations.bsb: As the troops were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs, and with tambourines and other instruments.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
translations.asv: And it came to pass as they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with timbrels, with joy, and with instruments of music.
